name: inline-headroom
description: Headroom-style levers inside Claude Code as a mod: clamp-only effort routing after successful tool results, a detector-only CacheAligner that logs cache-hit drops, and a SmartCrusher with lossless compaction, cross-turn dedup, a dense line elider, a config compressor, an HTML extractor, log, search and diff compressors, a text crusher and a relevance split that shrink tool results before the model reads them (originals retrievable, custom workflow tags kept whole). Ships a host-wide SQLite storage MCP server for persistent plugin data.

cache_aligner_enabled.title: CacheAligner
cache_aligner_enabled.description: Log prompt-cache hit-ratio drops per main-loop step. Never rewrites the prompt.

effort_routing_enabled.title: Effort routing
effort_routing_enabled.description: Lower thinking effort to low on main-loop steps that only resume after successful tool results. Never raises or injects effort. Note: an effort switch may invalidate prompt cache.

subagent_effort_routing_enabled.title: Subagent effort routing
subagent_effort_routing_enabled.description: Also lower thinking effort to low on subagent and Workflow-agent steps that only resume after that agent's successful tool results. Only active while effort routing is on. Overrides effort set on purpose (agent frontmatter, Agent tool or Workflow effort), and each subagent may pay its own prompt-cache re-write per switch.

smart_crusher_enabled.title: SmartCrusher
smart_crusher_enabled.description: Compress large JSON arrays in successful tool results of any tool (headroom SmartCrusher): keeps first/last, error, outlier, anomaly and query-relevant rows; dropped rows stay retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

lossless_compaction_enabled.title: Lossless compaction
lossless_compaction_enabled.description: Before the SmartCrusher drops rows, rewrite a large JSON array of objects as one schema line plus CSV rows when that saves at least 15% (headroom lossless compaction): nothing is dropped, so nothing needs retrieving. Also runs while the SmartCrusher is off. Never rewrites error results.

config_compressor_enabled.title: Config compressor
config_compressor_enabled.description: Shorten YAML, TOML and INI tool results (headroom ConfigCompressor): repeated lines and repeated multi-line blocks fold behind exact back-reference markers, and whole-line comments and blank lines are dropped behind a retrieval marker; the original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

cross_turn_dedup_enabled.title: Cross-turn dedup
cross_turn_dedup_enabled.description: Replace a run of 3 or more lines (40+ characters) in a tool result that repeats an earlier tool result of the same conversation verbatim with a short pointer (headroom cross-turn dedup); the run stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

dense_line_elider_enabled.title: Dense line elider
dense_line_elider_enabled.description: Shorten long, nearly space-free lines (minified JS/CSS, base64, RSC payloads) in tool results to their head and tail once they add up to 2000+ characters (headroom dense line elider); the original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

html_extractor_enabled.title: HTML extractor
html_extractor_enabled.description: Turn HTML tool results (web pages) into markdown-like text (headings, lists, links, tables) without scripts, styles, navigation, footers and other boilerplate, a bounded stand-in for headroom's trafilatura extractor; the original page stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results.

log_compressor_enabled.title: Log compressor
log_compressor_enabled.description: Shorten build and test logs of 50+ lines in tool results (headroom LogCompressor): keeps errors, failures, deduplicated warnings, stack traces with runtime frames collapsed, summary lines and their context, plus an omitted-lines summary; a lossless fold (ANSI colour dropped, repeated lines collapsed) wins when the cut saves under 5% more. The original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results or Read output.

search_compressor_enabled.title: Search compressor
search_compressor_enabled.description: Shorten grep and ripgrep results in tool results (headroom SearchCompressor): per file the first, last and most relevant matches (error words and words from the conversation rank higher), at most 15 files and 30 matches, with a count of the rest; a lossless fold (one heading per repeated file or directory) wins when the cut saves under 5% more. The original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results or Read output.

diff_compressor_enabled.title: Diff compressor
diff_compressor_enabled.description: Shorten git diffs of 50+ lines in tool results (headroom DiffCompressor): at most 20 files and 10 hunks per file (the first, the last and the most relevant), 2 context lines around each change, with a changed-lines summary; dropping git's index lines wins when the cut saves under 5% more. The original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results or Read output.

text_crusher_enabled.title: Text crusher
text_crusher_enabled.description: Shorten prose tool results of 6+ sentences, subagent reports and markdown output included (headroom TextCrusher, standing in for its ML Kompress): keeps about half the characters, preferring recent, query-relevant and fact-dense sentences and dropping near-duplicates; collapsing repeated lines wins when the cut saves under 5% more. Line breaks and indentation of the kept sentences are not kept. The original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results or Read output.

relevance_split_enabled.title: Relevance split
relevance_split_enabled.description: In prose tool results, keep the records (paragraphs, short line groups) that match the conversation's recent requests and elide the rest behind one-line notes (headroom relevance split, BM25 scoring); a record group holding an error word is always kept, and a result where nothing matches is left to the text crusher. The original stays retrievable via headroom_retrieve while the mod is loaded. Never rewrites error results or Read output.

tag_protector_enabled.title: Tag protector
tag_protector_enabled.description: Keep custom workflow tags such as <system-reminder>…</system-reminder> whole in tool results (headroom tag protector): no compression lever drops, elides, folds or extracts the part of a result holding one, and a result too tag-dense to scan within budget is left untouched. Only matters while a compression lever is on.

subagent_compression_enabled.title: Subagent compression
subagent_compression_enabled.description: Also apply the SmartCrusher, lossless compaction, cross-turn dedup, the dense line elider, the config compressor, the HTML extractor, the log, search and diff compressors, the text crusher and the relevance split to subagent and Workflow-agent tool results. Only active while one of them is on. An agent type whose tool list leaves out headroom_retrieve cannot get the originals back.

storage_enabled.title: Persistent storage
storage_enabled.description: Run the host-wide SQLite storage service (one background process per host; data in the plugin data directory, kept across updates). Fail-closed: only true enables it.
